title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Headroom Allowance for a Surviving Borrower in Care
content:
The survivor allowance added to a passed due date when an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is reclassified after a certifying borrower's death includes a **headroom allowance**. It is read from the facility admission date stated on the primary borrower's accepted health-care absence notice received most recently, measured in whole calendar months before the handling date:

| Facility admission on that notice | Headroom allowance |
|---|---|
| fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date | 30 days |
| 6 or more but fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it | 15 days |
| 12 or more whole calendar months before it | zero days |
| no accepted health-care absence notice about the primary borrower on file | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

## Month boundaries (hypothetical dates)

- Admission 10 March, handling date 9 September of the same year: 5 whole months — 30 days.
- Admission 10 March, handling date 10 September: 6 whole months — 15 days.
- Admission 10 March, handling date 10 March of the next year: 12 whole months — zero days.
